title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 10

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the induction take place?
tasks.audioText: Good morning, everyone. The workshop induction will take place in Room 14 on Thursday at ten. Please bring your student card and wear safety shoes. The instructor will explain the emergency exits and show you where to find the first-aid kit. Do not use any machine until you have completed the induction. If you cannot attend, contact the workshop office before Wednesday afternoon.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What must students do before using a machine?
tasks.audioText: Good morning, everyone. The workshop induction will take place in Room 14 on Thursday at ten. Please bring your student card and wear safety shoes. The instructor will explain the emergency exits and show you where to find the first-aid kit. Do not use any machine until you have completed the induction. If you cannot attend, contact the workshop office before Wednesday afternoon.

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. Leo is preparing for his first workshop lesson. He checks the timetable and notices that the group must wear safety shoes. He puts his notebook and student card in his bag. At the workshop door, he waits for the instructor, who explains the safety signs and the location of the emergency stop button. Leo asks a question when he does not understand an instruction. What does Leo put in his bag?
options: A safety helmet and a camera

tasks.prompt: Reading 2. When does Leo ask a question?
options: Only at the end of the course

tasks.prompt: Choose the correct form: 'Students ___ wear safety shoes in the workshop.'
Complete with one word: 'A person who teaches or shows you how to do a job is an ___.'
A machine is ready, but you cannot identify the emergency-stop control. What should you do before starting?
options: Start slowly and look for the control while the machine is running.
Ask a classmate to point it out after the task begins.
Ask the instructor to show you the emergency-stop control before the machine is started.
Use the control that looks most familiar.

tasks.prompt: Put the steps for entering a workshop in a sensible order.
options: Listen to the instructor's safety briefing
correctOrder: Listen to the instructor's safety briefing

tasks.prompt: Write 60–80 words about preparing for a safe workshop lesson. Mention two items you need, one rule you must follow and what you should do if an instruction is unclear.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: two necessary items and one applicable workshop rule are identified (0–2); the response explains that unclear instructions must be clarified with the instructor before proceeding (0–2); steps and reasons are presented clearly with understandable grammar (0–2); workshop/safety vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are appropriate (0–2).
